exceptions.why: Modern thumbnail reads use rawProps.data() when YouTube's data property is a Symbol placeholder; the shared live-read port also probes the accessor. A search channel card's shelf lockups hold no data, so theirs is read from the card's.
The Music page bundle includes the shared live-read port, including the modern thumbnail accessor support and the channel card read used on YouTube.

The shared site core validates picker membership and timestamped health reports, delivers its health batch at once when Check now asks, reports a lost batch again, and asks the background for a broken feature's not-working notice while the tab is visible.

The Music picker asks the background for membership so the fallback uses a tab with the same account and privacy mode. The core delivers its health batch at once when Check now asks, reports a lost batch again, and asks the background for a broken feature's not-working notice while the tab is visible.

The popup validates the casting-specific health status in the shared health contract, reads the status again when a tab opens or a breakage signal lands, and reads the name of an account with no setup from its tab.

The Music popup shares the health contract that identifies casting failures separately from unavailable actions, reads the status again when a tab opens or a breakage signal lands, and shows the live account name.
Thumbnail overlays track page pointer, mouse and drag gestures so they cannot intercept the release that ends queue reordering.
The in-page Save picker now includes its own control utilities and a small shadow-root reset so YouTube's styles and 10px root cannot leave controls unstyled or shrink the text.
Feature selection includes localized examples and a loader for the illustrated previews. The illustration component is a separate lazy chunk. The shared UI contract includes the live account name.
The upgrade entry shares the first-run shell, including the localized example captions and lazy preview loader, and the shared UI contract.

The card menu finds the card under YouTube's hover preview and leaves the preview's own links to the browser. It opens a keyboard-opened menu at the card's own menu button when the browser reports no point on the card.
